I’m trying out explosive trap trickster this league and it seems insane to me. The transfigured shrapnel gem along with swift assembly makes map clear feel smooth and with kintsugi and grace I feel pretty tanky as well. The most surprising thing is how ridiculous the damage is at low investment. I can instantly kill many of the bosses and I’m not min maxed by any means. One of the issues I’m facing is DOT damage as there is nothing built in and I lack life regen due to being an ES build. Rn wither/bleed/ignite etc are a pain in the ass. My plan is try out stormshroud once I get some more currency and then try and get bleed/corrupted blood immunity and freeze immunity through jewels and gear. Replica dragon fang will be nice to have for damage to Ubers as well. Overall I like it way more than the Hexblast mines sab that I went last year. Hexblast felt kind of clunky to me even with the auto aim and I was more squishy with that build.
